top_signals.title: EM Assets Buoyed by Easing US Rate Worries, Gains in AI Leaders
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market stocks and currencies gain as a retreat in a key US inflation measure strengthened hopes that the Federal Reserve may not have to raise interest rates soon.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Why a Costly US Bond Sale Is a Warning to Bessent
top_signals.summary: The US government sold 30-year bonds at the highest interest rate in a quarter century, a testament to investors’ demand for greater compensation to finance the nation’s growing deficit. Standard Chartered CIO for North Asia, Raymond Cheng, discusses how long such yields will remain sustainable. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: PBOC’s First Mid-Month Overnight Reverse Repo Boosts Bonds
top_signals.summary: China’s central bank injected liquidity through overnight reverse repos on Friday, marking its first such operation in the middle of a month in a boost to bond bulls.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: VW’s Overhaul Puts Truckmaker Stake in Focus as Sell-Down Looms
top_signals.summary: Volkswagen AG’s push to cut costs is spilling over to truckmaker Traton SE, where the German company is also preparing to reduce a majority stake currently worth €16.6 billion ($19.1 billion).

top_signals.title: Bitwise mulls tokenizing its Solana staking ETF via Superstate partnership
top_signals.summary: Shares held in tokenized form would carry the same rights as those in book-entry form, though not freely transferable outside the system.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
